Touche une case : ajoute une note. Touch: Tap a cell: adds a note. Tap a note: selects it. Long press: its menu (copy, delete…). Drag: moves, the end: lengthens. Numbers on top: a whole bar. Bottom lane: drag to set the velocity.
Un passe-bas à %s : il garde le grave et: A low-pass at %s: it keeps the lows and softens the highs.
Un passe-bande autour de %s : il ne gard: A band-pass around %s: it keeps only that part of the sound.
Un passe-haut à %s : il enlève le grave: A high-pass at %s: it removes the lows below it.
Réussi ! La couleur du morceau est chois: Done! The song's colour is chosen.
